label: Testimonial Card
description: A customer testimonial at video scale: a brand quote glyph, the quote rising line by line with an optional highlighted phrase swept in, gold stars, and the person (photo or initials, name, role) with the company wordmark or logo.

avatar_color.label: Initials circle color (default: the brand primary)

highlight.label: A phrase copied exactly from the quote to sweep a highlight across

avatar.label: Photo URL (brand-kit headshot); initials when absent

company_logo.label: Company logo image URL (replaces the company wordmark)

theme.label: Card theme; omit to follow the scene ground (a dark ground gets a dark card)

at.label: Seconds into the scene the card enters (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
